title: Lightly Grilled Vietnamese Frankfurter Noodles
description: A sweet and savory Vietnamese dish featuring grilled frankfurter and noodles, perfect for a solo dinner. This dish is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium high heat.
Grill the frankfurter for 5 minutes on each side, or until lightly charred.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, and brown sugar.
Add the cooked noodles, grated carrot, and chopped cilantro to the bowl and toss to combine.
Slice the grilled frankfurter and add to the bowl, tossing to combine.
Drizzle with vegetable oil and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional cilantro and carrot if desired.
